items.text: Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. New Orleans: OUT last week - C Erik McCoy, RT Taliese Fuaga, OL Asim Richards (knee, out a few weeks per Kellen Moore). QUESTIONABLE - LB Pete Werner (hamstring). IR - DT Christen Miller, DT Bryan Bresee. Tyler Shough starts. If McCoy and Fuaga stay out, the OL cluster may justify a CHI adjustment later in the week.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Chicago (off a bye): RB Kyle Monangai (toe/thumb) says he is on track to return. WR Luther Burden III (concussion) must clear protocol. IR - OT Braxton Jones (season), TE Cole Kmet (season), S Coby Bryant. Caleb Williams starts.
